added.d: With no plot details provided, this looks like a restrained mystery-drama that can plausibly fit his preference for serious, grounded storytelling, but there is not enough evidence to rate it as strongly realistic or emotionally rich as his top courtroom and justice-driven favorites. Its short 6-episode length is an excellent format match, and it most closely resembles Beyond the Bar in being a compact, serious case-or-mystery-led drama rather than a stylized action show.
